title: A Few Bad Neurons: Isolating and Surgically Correcting Sycophancy

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using multiple benchmarks (Syco-Bench, Open-Ended-Sycophancy) to measure the model's tendency to exhibit unwarranted deference, flattery, delusion acceptance, and mirroring of user preferences by calculating the rate at which the model selects sycophantic responses over neutral or factual ones.
Assessed using the POLI dataset from Perez et al. (2022) to measure the model's sycophantic tendencies and preference for agreeing with specific political stances presented in a prompt.
